description: Loopback/localhost detection over additional boundary inputs: an uppercase host, a deeper sub-domain of the localhost suffix, a spoofed host that merely embeds a loopback literal, a bracketed IPv6 loopback, a near-miss suffix, and an all-zeros host. For each URL the output reports whether it is a localhost address.
